description:
## What

After a `Compaction` entry is successfully appended (auto, manual, or extension-driven), `Coder.Loop` calls:

```elixir
new_path = SessionStore.path(store, :leaf, to: :latest_compaction)
```

and replaces `state.path`. This is the SAME call branch-switch (`navigate_tree`) makes after moving the leaf. Removes the asymmetry where compaction appends but Loop's path keeps growing, while navigate refreshes Loop's path explicitly.

Matches the upstream invariant: after compaction, the LLM sees `[summary] + [tail since cut]` — modeled here as Loop's `:path` literally being `[compaction_entry, ...kept tail]`.

## Why

Unifies two code paths that today do different things to `:path`. After this ticket, both compaction and navigate use the same one-liner to refresh Loop's view, and the compactor's invariant — "my input is everything since the latest anchor" — falls out naturally because `:path` already starts at the latest anchor.

## Files

- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/loop.ex` — `do_compact/2`, `persist_compaction/4`, `finish_compaction/6`, `handle_info CompactionRequested`, `do_navigate_tree/2` — all converge on the same `Store.path(server, :leaf, to: :latest_compaction)` rewrite

## Out of scope

- The branch-switch case (it already refreshes path; just confirm it uses the same call shape).
- Visual / UI re-render concerns; this is state-only.

## Done when

- After auto-compaction (overflow + threshold), Loop's `:path` starts with the new `Compaction` entry.
- After manual compaction, same.
- Existing compaction tests still pass; new test verifies `state.path` shape pre/post compact.
- Tests confirm the next prompt's turn context (`messages_provider` output) is `[CompactionSummaryMessage | kept_tail]`.
title: Unify post-compact and post-navigate path-reset on Store.path/2
